note: How to close a rubric gap: dim -> harness modules (M0-M8) + catalog kinds to pull tools from. Consumed by `harness standard plan`. Anchors to Claude/Anthropic's documented practice where one exists.

default.note: Anchor to a named, sourced bar and verify against it (M3/M4).

deep-research.name: Claude Research (Opus 4 lead + Sonnet 4 subagents)
deep-research.note: Orchestrator-worker + parallel subagents (own context) + a citation agent. +90.2% over single-agent Opus 4 on Anthropic's internal research eval; token spend explains ~80% of BrowseComp variance. Published 2025-06-13.

software-engineering.name: Anthropic engineering practice (Building effective agents + Writing effective tools for agents)
software-engineering.benchmark: Anthropic's three agent principles: simplicity, transparency, careful ACI
software-engineering.note: Simplicity over framework complexity; keep the LLM+tools loop small; invest in the agent-computer interface (ACI) as much as in HCI; start simple, add complexity only when it demonstrably improves outcomes. Companion: https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/writing-tools-for-agents (evaluate tools, distinct purposes, token-efficient responses). Self-applied to this project.

excellence.name: Anthropic's agent evaluation discipline
excellence.benchmark: LLM-as-judge rubric + human review over ~20 representative tasks
excellence.note: Outcome-based eval; LLM judge on accuracy/citation/completeness/source quality/tool efficiency; keep human review because it catches what automation misses (e.g. source-quality bias). Moving frontier: re-check on a cadence.

fidelity.note: Anchor every claim to a source; run a citation pass before output.
fidelity.claude: A dedicated CitationAgent checks each claim against its source.

coverage.note: Widen the search matrix; explore angles in parallel, not serially.
coverage.claude: 3-5 subagents run in parallel; start wide, then narrow.

contradiction-honesty.note: Actively surface conflicting evidence and report it; do not smooth it over.

calibration.note: Attach an eval, report confidence/limits, re-baseline when the bar moves.
calibration.claude: LLM-as-judge rubric (factual accuracy, citation, completeness, source quality, tool efficiency) over ~20 queries; keep human review.

insight.note: Add a synthesis step beyond aggregation; connect non-obvious findings.

clarity.note: Structure and edit the final synthesis; plain language.

polish.note: Final review pass against the bar.

rigor.note: State assumptions; add an adversarial/verification pass.

reproducibility.note: Make the recipe re-runnable; pin inputs and versions.

intent.note: Recover the author's intent, not just the words.

gap-closure.note: Close the largest weighted gap first; one lever at a time.

bar-quality.note: Name a sourced, measurable bar; human confirms it (M0.8).

measurement-rigor.note: Measure artifact and bar with the same ruler, with evidence.

ratchet-discipline.note: Never regress; the floor only rises.

frontier-awareness.note: Track the moving SOTA; re-check the bar on a cadence.

findability.note: Index, tag, and make the corpus searchable.

freshness.note: Set TTLs and a refresh cadence.

validity.note: Establish construct validity; keep claims falsifiable.

evaluation.note: Define metrics and a hold-out before optimizing.

impact.note: State who benefits and the reach.

tests.note: Automated tests with coverage on the risky paths.

security.note: Threat-model; least privilege; sandbox the execution surface (capability: sandboxed-execution). Where the harness emits skills, triage the skills execution layer against OWASP AST10 (R245): malicious / over-privileged skills, insecure metadata, update drift, weak isolation. Enforcement architecture exemplar: OWASP ACS (R271) - lifecycle hooks + allow/deny/modify/ask/defer dispositions, deterministic layer first; its v0.1.0 fail-open default is the anti-pattern.

reliability.claude: Durable state + resume-from-checkpoint so minor tool failures don't cascade.

observability.note: Full tracing of decisions and tool calls.

cost.note: Budget tokens/price; scale effort to query complexity.
cost.claude: Scale effort to complexity (1 agent/3-10 calls -> 10+ subagents). Multi-agent ~15x chat tokens; justify by value.

characterization.note: Characterize the result adequately before claims.

safety.note: Enumerate hazards/contraindications; human gate for harm.

generality.note: State the scope; test edge cases.

efficacy.note: Use effect sizes from trials, not mechanism alone.

guideline-adherence.note: Follow current clinical guidelines; cite them.

identification.note: State and defend the causal identification strategy.

authority.note: Use binding sources; respect the hierarchy of authority.

interpretation.note: Ground the reading; weigh competing readings.

originality.note: State the contribution against prior work.

fit.note: Match model/config to the task; evaluate before committing.
